Problem, already measured: `evaluate()` lazily builds a git-less tree export (`git archive | tar -x`) and runs each cited fact command there with `bash -c`. Two facts in the current `## Axes` table are git-dependent — the operability row's `python3 tools/gate-registry-check.py --selftest` (its lane-tip arm resolves a repo, so it exits 1 in a git-less export) and the calibration row's `python3 tools/round69-newest-closure-counter.py --since-round 63` (exit 2 without repository metadata) — so at base 6035e952 the reconciler reports `r41=2`. The harness must execute commands against the tip, not a metadata-free export.

Deliver in `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-70/w1/out/EX01ReconHarness/`:
1. `round41-scorecard-reconcile.py` — the full candidate file bytes (keep the docstring truthful; date the change as round 70).
2. `diff.patch` — `git -C /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin diff --no-index` or `diff -u` old vs new.
3. `demo.md` — the exact commands and outputs proving: (a) old bytes reproduce `r41=2` at base; (b) new bytes give `r41=0` at base while the other counters are unchanged; (c) the selftest arms of the imported counter (if any) still pass; (d) a git-dependent fact and a git-independent fact both reproduce.
4. `report.md` per the wave contract.

Constraints: the change may only affect WHERE commands run (and the cleanup of that location); every check, counter name, regex, needle, threshold and the `mismatches` arithmetic must stay byte-identical in behaviour. Prefer `git clone --shared --no-checkout` + `checkout --detach <tip>` (or `git worktree add --detach` with a real removal) over a full clone; honour TMPDIR and delete the checkout before exit. If you replace the export, keep the exported-bytes semantics documented and prove the checkout's tree equals the tip tree (`git -C <co> rev-parse HEAD` == tip, `git -C <co> status --porcelain` empty).
Do not change `tools/round42-selfdesc-reconcile.py`.

Act directly via tool calls. ## EX02CensusVerdict Repair the verdict accounting in `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/tools/round65-host-census.py` (claim C2). Problem, already measured by the frozen control: `main()` returns `0 if failed == 0 else 1`, so a member that emits a registered refusal marker (or exceeds the budget, or hits the OS error path) disappears from the exit code. At base the control prints `REFUSED_MEMBER_CONTROL refused_fixture_exit=0 allpass_fixture_exit=0` (receipt `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-70/measured/before/refused-member-control-old.out`). fail= not_evaluated= waived= total= tierA_fail= tierB_fail=`. Exit 0 only when `fail=0` AND every not-evaluated member is named by an explicit `--waive ` (repeatable, exact member name) — a waived member prints its reason and the verdict keeps `waived=` visible; a not-evaluated member with no waiver makes exit 1. Keep each member's real semantics intact: a member that fails stays `fail`; a member that passes stays `pass`. Deliver in `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-70/w1/out/EX02CensusVerdict/`: 1. `round65-host-census.py` — full candidate bytes (docstring updated, dated round 70). 2. `diff.patch`. 3. `demo.md` — exact commands/outputs for: the frozen control on your bytes (must print refused_fixture_exit=1, allpass_fixture_exit=0, and the refused fixture's verdict line must carry `not_evaluated=1`); the real census on this host (`python3 tools/round65-host-census.py`) — report its line and exit while C1 is still red (expect `tierA_fail=1`), and again with `--waive "round42-selfdesc-reconcile selftest"` if you want to show the waiver path; a proof that an always-exit-1 shim FAILS the all-pass fixture (the kill rule). 4. `report.md` per the wave contract. Do not change the member list, markers, tiers or budget. Do not change `tools/round42-selfdesc-reconcile.py`.
